role: independent verifier (own code under roles/verifier/code/; labels only via tsz.common.load operation verify)
rules: append-only: a check entry is never edited or removed; every version is snapshotted to records/history/
kind NUMERICAL_REPLAY (own code recomputes a recorded number) and PROCEDURAL_COMPLIANCE (process, access and record evidence) are kept separate
an acceptance rule is never widened; a corrected check gets a new id and an entry in CHECK_CHANGES.json (before, after, cause); the earlier result is kept
statuses: PASS, FAIL, ATTENTION (no registered criterion failed, but a discrepancy or caveat the coordinator must see), NOT_RUN
